info.name: MarkdownSite
info.summary: Browse a folder of Markdown as a wiki
info.description: Turn any folder of Markdown files into a browsable, read-only wiki site inside Nextcloud. Supports Obsidian-style wikilinks, embeds and YAML frontmatter. Links resolve by path, so a synced Obsidian vault or any Markdown folder just works. Content stays editable in the Files app or via desktop sync; the reader reflects changes live.
info.author: QTL
